title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing powerful new capabilities to elevate your experience.

title: Master Your Content: Advanced File Management
summary: Gain complete control over your embedded files with new tools to easily upload, manage, and customize their display right within the editor.

title: Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page offers complete transparency into our product's evolution, showcasing recent updates, current priorities, and future visions in one accessible place.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more responsive and modern experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for seamless task management.

title: Enhanced Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded your collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work together in real-time.

title: Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: We're thrilled to introduce enhanced ways to discover and collaborate on shared items, making teamwork and idea exchange effortless.

title: Noeko: Empowering You with Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, giving you unprecedented control, fostering direct community involvement, and providing complete transparency into our progress.

title: Expand Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Get ready for a visual upgrade as we refine current themes and unveil a vibrant array of new designs to suit every preference.

title: Navigate Your Knowledge with Advanced Graph Filters
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your knowledge map by applying intuitive filters for tags and time, allowing you to discover connections and manage shared items with ease.

title: Powerful Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Unlock a new level of knowledge discovery by applying advanced filters and sorting options, then save your tailored searches as personalized collections for seamless access.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Experience a more intuitive and dynamic way to structure your notes and ideas, thanks to flexible display options and enhanced interactivity for your connected content.

title: Introducing Flexible Hosting and Premium Features for Noeko
summary: Empower your team with Noeko's versatile new self-hosting capabilities and premium features designed to scale with your needs.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the most accurate and welcoming message, precisely reflecting your local time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Management in List Views
summary: Streamline your workflow by quickly removing tags from multiple items directly within your lists, enhancing your productivity and organization.

title: Universal Content Input
summary: Seamlessly integrate information from a wider array of sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize and enrich your knowledge effortlessly.
